description: THE USER TYPE THE PROGRAM NEVER DERIVES, CARRIED ACROSS A TRANSFER THAT NEVER RETURNS. app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl:150 - MOVE SEC-USR-TYPE TO CDEMO-USER-TYPE - is COMMENTED OUT, and it is the program's only mention of any field of the CSUSR01Y record it copies at line 58, so nothing in these 282 lines derives, defaults, re-reads or validates CDEMO-USER-TYPE PIC X(01) (app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:26). This case proves that with a byte satisfying NEITHER 88 CDEMO-USRTYP-ADMIN VALUE 'A' (:27) NOR 88 CDEMO-USRTYP-USER VALUE 'U' (:28): an 'X' must cross the whole dispatch path and reach the successor exactly as the client sent it, and CDEMO-USER-ID PIC X(08) must do the same because line 149 is commented out beside it. THE PATH. CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives 1, so line 87 takes the ELSE of IF NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER and line 92 performs RECEIVE-MENU-SCREEN; the ordered EVALUATE EIBAID at 93-103 then takes its FIRST arm, WHEN DFHENTER at 94. The attention identifier is declared by mnemonic and resolved from common.CicsAid rather than hand-typed as a byte, because DFHAID is IBM-supplied and absent from this repository - 17 programs COPY it, COMEN01C at line 60 - so that class is the single reproduction of it (risk R-D). OPTIONI PIC X(2) (app/cpy-bms/COMEN01.CPY:132) IS consulted on this arm, unlike on the other two: lines 117-121 scan it from the right and stop at WS-IDX 2 because byte two is '2', line 122 moves both bytes into WS-OPTION-X PIC X(02) JUST RIGHT, line 123 finds no space to INSPECT away, line 124 leaves WS-OPTION at 02 and line 125 echoes '02' into OPTIONO. The three-term guard at 127-129 is false on every term - 02 is numeric, 02 is not greater than the CDEMO-MENU-OPT-COUNT of 10 (app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy:21) and 02 is not zero - so no validation message is composed at 131-132, and the ungated filter at 136-137 is decided by its FIRST conjunct alone: 88 CDEMO-USRTYP-USER is false for 'X', so the option is dispatched rather than refused and the refusal composed at 140-141 is never reached. Line 145 finds WS-ERR-FLG still OFF from line 77, line 146 finds COACTUPC's leading five bytes to be 'COACT' and not 'DUMMY', lines 147, 148 and 151 write CM00, COMEN01C and 0 into CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM and CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT, and the XCTL at 152-155 transfers WITH the communication area. Nothing here writes CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM, which only the PF3 arm at 97 and the signon default at 173 do, so it returns as it arrived; CDEMO-LAST-MAP and CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET are referenced nowhere in the program and likewise return untouched. This is also the second slot of gate G33: option 02 must resolve the 1-based SECOND entry of CDEMO-MENU-OPT OCCURS 12 TIMES (app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy:88), whose CDEMO-MENU-OPT-PGMNAME PIC X(08) (:91) holds COACTUPC (:34) - a translation indexing from zero would dispatch the first entry instead, and both entries exist, so only naming the successor catches it. WHAT IS ASSERTED ABSENT. An EXEC CICS XCTL never returns, so lines 157-164 do not execute: neither the MOVE DFHGREEN TO ERRMSGC at 158 nor the STRING composed at 159-163 happens, and expectedMessages carries WS-MESSAGE PIC X(80) (app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl:38) exactly as the MOVE SPACES of line 79 left it - eighty space characters on the WS_MESSAGE_80 channel, not the seventy-eight of ERRMSGO PIC X(78) (app/cpy-bms/COMEN01.CPY:138), because the eighty-to-seventy-eight narrowing is line 187's work inside SEND-MENU-SCREEN and no send happens on a transfer. That eighty-byte image is deliberately NOT CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY PIC X(50) (app/cpy/CSMSG01Y.cpy:20) left-justified and space-padded from fifty to eighty: that image belongs to the WHEN OTHER arm at 99-102 and is pinned by case15 on this same eighty-byte channel and by case16 on the seventy-eight-byte screen channel, so a translation that fell out of the first arm into the third fails here on the message alone. Nor is it either farewell the program copies but never references - CCDA-MSG-THANK-YOU PIC X(50) (app/cpy/CSMSG01Y.cpy:18) and CCDA-THANK-YOU PIC X(40) (app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:23), for which an exhaustive search of app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl returns no hit at all. Both stay dead, neither wired up nor removed, exactly as the commented lines 149 and 150 do. sends is empty and no mapset or map is named, because MAP('COMEN1A') and MAPSET('COMEN01') at 190-191 sit inside SEND-MENU-SCREEN, which a transfer never performs, and naming them would tell the client to paint the screen the program is leaving; the successor travels as a response field with the whole conversation in the payload and no server-side forward or session state - gates G37 and G40. ERRMSGC is not written on this path at all and keeps the mapset's declared COLOR=RED (app/bms/COMEN01.bms:154-157), which line 158 is the sole override of; no DFHRED-plus-asterisk highlight appears anywhere in this folder, because COMEN01C copies no CSSETATY - its sole consumer is app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl - so gate G38 is honoured through the ENTER/REENTER split rather than through a highlight, and this is a REENTER-side case that nonetheless emits no error output. CDEMO-USER-TYPE is trusted exactly as it arrives and is never looked up in USRSEC, re-verified or hashed: the single X(01) comparison at 137 is the whole authorisation mechanism, and the logical file WS-USRSEC-FILE names at line 39 is never opened, so this case seeds no dataset and asserts none. The clock is pinned at the source footer instant that all twenty cases in this folder share, which keeps the run reproducible even though POPULATE-HEADER-INFO at 212-231 does not execute on a transfer, so neither CURDATE as mm/dd/yy nor CURTIME as hh:mm:ss is produced here (app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy). The unit is admin.MainMenuService driven directly, with no MockMvc, no HTTP and no JobLauncher - gate G51; inputs, expectedWrites and expectedFinalState are empty because the program declares no SELECT and no FD and issues no file verb; expectedReturnCode is 0 because an online transaction sets none, and an unrecognised user type is not an abend. Every value here is STATICALLY DERIVED from the COBOL source, the copybooks and the BMS definitions and was NEVER captured from a live COBOL execution - no such runtime exists in this environment, per the eight verified blockers recorded in 0.7.6 of the plan (risk R-A). Gates pinned: G15, G18, G30 first arm, G33 second slot, G37, G38, G40, G51.
